support_spans.quote: We propose MusicRL, the first music generation system finetuned from human feedback. Not only this makes supervised training of such models challenging, but it also calls for integrating continuous human feedback in their post-deployment finetuning. To address this issue, we represent an emotion as a point in the Cartesian space with valence and arousal as the dimensions and determine the coordinates of a song by the relative emotion of the song with respect to other songs. We also develop an RBF-ListNet algorithm to optimize the ranking-based objective function of our approach.
